descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for Android Engineers to join our team. As part of a cross-functional scrum team you will design and develop new investment account and cash account functionality within our Android app. In addition to development on the app itself, you will write automated tests and integrate with our in-house design systems and our backend API. Come help us achieve our vision to make investing delightfully easy and understandable for our clients and prospective clients!
About Wealthfront Engineering
Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation: 
 
• Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better.
 
• Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution.
 
• Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront.
 
• Wealthfront engineers automate observability in case of failure. If something is up, our systems inform engineers appropriately. If our systems are quiet, they are healthy.
 
If you are drawn to being an engineer within such an environment, and having outsized impact as an engineer at a magnitude that is only available within a company achieving greatness at our size (~350 employees, half in engineering), then we want to hear from you!

descriptionPlain:
Wealthfront is seeking a talented, passionate, and detail-oriented Anti-Money Laundering (AML) compliance professional to join its AML Monitoring team. As the newest member of AML Monitoring, this individual will play a key role in Wealthfront’s newly formalized triage function, through which all referrals of potentially suspicious activity — including requests under Section 314(a) and 314(b) of the USA PATRIOT Act, subpoenas, and internal referrals from across the firm — are assessed prior to escalation to the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU). 
The ideal candidate will be someone who enjoys hands-on investigative work, possesses a strong degree of intellectual curiosity, holds an interest in applying technology to enhance business processes, and will be looking to continue developing their AML skillset in an individual contributor capacity. This individual will work closely with other members of the Legal and Compliance division and collaborate with other departments across the firm including Fraud Operations, Product Support, and Engineering.

lists.content:
• Review and disposition transaction monitoring alerts in accordance with established procedures, determining whether escalation to the FIU is warranted

  • Conduct in-depth reviews of transactional activity, internal KYC records, and open source research in support of triage and monitoring functions

  • Maintain accurate and well-documented records of triage decisions and alert dispositions to ensure consistency, auditability, and stakeholder transparency

  • Partner with Engineering teams to develop new and enhance existing transaction monitoring processes

  • Leverage expertise to assist in the identification of unusual financial activity indicating potential money laundering, terrorist financing, and fraud

  • Conduct deep-dives into account and transaction activity to identify and expand upon existing Fraud and AML typologies

  • Support Wealthfront's suspicious activity detection, transaction monitoring, and reporting programs and drive enhancements to the program, including updates to related controls and accompanying policies and procedures

  • Assist with Wealthfront's adverse media and PEP watchlist screening

  • Maintain awareness of and provide thought leadership on impending regulatory changes

• Deep, wide, and practical understanding of money laundering typologies and related red flags

  • Adept at conducting triage or initial assessments of potentially suspicious activity referrals, including determining whether escalation to an investigations team is warranted

  • Experience reviewing potentially suspicious activity spanning cash management, automated investment advisory, brokerage, and home lending products

  • Familiarity with subpoenas as well as requests received under Section 314(a) and 314(b) of the USA PATRIOT Act

  • Adept at developing, refining, and reviewing transaction monitoring parameters designed to surface suspicious activity

  • Excellent analytical and organizational skills, able to set and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong working knowledge of BSA/AML, FinCEN, FINRA, and SEC regulations

  • Experience leading cross-functional projects, including collaboration with engineering teams

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills

  • Intellectually curious and interested in applying technology to enhance business processes

  • Broad analytical skills, with experience identifying and quantifying problems while providing creative, effective solutions

• BA/BS degree

  • 2 - 4 years of direct or relevant experience conducting Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, or Follow-the-Money related analysis and/or investigations

  • Willingness to obtain applicable registrations and/or licenses as necessary

• CAMS or CFE certification

  • Experience at a Broker-Dealer and/or Registered Investment Adviser (RIA), including FINRA Series 7 and 24 registrations

  • Product experience spanning automated investment advisory, brokerage accounts, individual stock investing, cash management and checking products, portfolio lines of credit, and home lending products

  • Experience supporting AML compliance programs in a banking-as-a-service (BaaS) or bank partnership model

  • Experience with or general understanding of broader financial services including investment advisory, retail banking, and consumer lending

Engineering managers at Wealthfront have a solid background as hands-on engineers and have realized that they can have more impact through their organizations as leaders. The largest impact you will have will be through identifying, developing, and coaching “whole engineers” who take ownership of their projects. With guidance from you, the engineers on your team will take full responsibility for their work, which may include working with cross functional stakeholders directly, authoring their own engineering designs, performing and overseeing their implementations, and taking full responsibility for their code running in production. Along the way, you will also help us develop the engineering organization, taking a first principles approach to problems like hiring, performance reviews and project management.
 
About Wealthfront Engineering

• Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better.
 
• Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. • Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront.

lists.content:
• Support the monthly close process by preparing reports, tracking deliverables and helping ensure a smooth and timely close.

  • Analyze the income statement, balance sheet, and statement of cash flows to understand business performance and identify key drivers. 

  • Prepare detailed variance analyses by comparing actual results against forecasts and prior periods and providing commentary.

  • Work closely with the Accounting team to understand the business results and ensure financial information is complete and accurate.

  • Partner with teams across the business to gather assumptions, understand upcoming initiatives, and incorporate them into budgets and forecasts.

  • Improve recurring reports and identify opportunities to automate or simplify existing processes.

  • Support the semiannual budgeting processes and monthly rolling forecasts across the business.

  • Maintain and improve financial models used for planning and reporting.

  • Analyze business trends and help explain changes in financial performance.

  • Prepare recurring analyses that support planning and decision making.

  • Support the production of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial presentations for company leadership and external stakeholders.

  • Support ad-hoc analyses to answer new business questions and inform decision-making.

  • Help improve finance processes, reporting, and workflows as the company continues to scale.

• Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field, with a strong grasp of fundamental finance principles.

  • 2-4 years of experience in an FP&A, accounting, or a similar finance role.

  • A strong understanding of accounting principles and financial statements: 

    • Experience in financial modeling including working with a three-statement financial model is preferred.

    • Experience with enterprise accounting software (e.g., Netsuite) is preferred.

    • Experience with Google Workspace (G Suite) is a plus.

    • Database experience (e.g., SQL) is a plus.

    • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and taking ownership of your work.

    • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

    • Excellent attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate, high-quality work.

    • High integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial information.

*This role supports US-based remote work, or Palo Alto, CA based hybrid in-office.
 
We’re looking for iOS Engineers to join our team. As part of a cross-functional scrum team you will design and develop new investment account and cash account features within our iOS app. In addition to development on the app itself, you will write automated tests and integrate with our in-house design systems and our backend API. Come help our clients and prospective clients build wealth on their own terms!
 
About Wealthfront Engineering
Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation: 
 
• Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better.
 
• Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution.
 
• Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront.
 
• Wealthfront engineers automate observability in case of failure. If something is up, our systems inform engineers appropriately. If our systems are quiet, they are healthy.
 
If you are drawn to being an engineer within such an environment, and having outsized impact as an engineer at a magnitude that is only available within a company achieving greatness at our size (~350 employees, half in engineering), then we want to hear from you!

The Wealthfront Data Science Team utilizes our rich financial and behavioral data to influence key product and marketing decisions, as well as to safeguard our client’s information and assets. The team draws from backgrounds in Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics, and Natural Sciences. We value analytical rigor, clear communication, and proactivity. We believe that good ideas can come from anywhere and encourage Data Scientists to pursue self-directed explorations in search of business value. 

The Data Scientist in this role will be primarily embedded within Wealthfront’s new and quickly-growing Home Lending area. The vision of this area is to enable our clients to grow their wealth through leveraged home ownership.

lists.content:
• Build predictive models for potential purchasers or refinancers in our client base to enable efficient and targeted outreach

  • Analyze user behavior in web-based home lending tools and flows to identify patterns and optimize these experiences

  • Interpret and contextualize statistical results for business stakeholders and help translate numbers into recommendations

• Demonstrate a high degree of independence, proactivity, and curiosity - be the first to identify opportunities

  • Formulate project plans with clear rationale, candidate approaches and milestones

  • Communicate clearly and effectively with partners both within and outside the home lending area, through written documents, presentations, and in-person or video meetings

  • Identify key initiatives for the Home Lending area and champion the role of Data Science within these initiatives

  • Employ a high degree of mathematical rigor and best practices for software development.

  • Enhance overall Data Science team execution through hands-on help, design feedback and peer review

  • Depending on experience and interest, management of more junior Data Science team members.

• A Master's or a PhD degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Operations Research, Computer Science, Economics or Natural Sciences, with 6+ years of prior experience in a Data Science role. Exceptions to these requirements may be considered on a case-by-case basis.  

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills and a record of partnering across organizations to sharpen project requirements. Sometimes this includes re-framing the original request to solve a more general problem with similar effort. 

  • Hands-on mathematical and software engineering skills to execute on complex projects.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL.

  • Desire and ability to mentor junior Data Scientists within the team by exemplifying math, engineering and technical communication skills.

descriptionPlain:
We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Devops Platform team, where you will blend linux system administration and software engineering skills to build and maintain all our infrastructure and core services running in our data centers and the cloud.
 
Wealthfront’s Infrastructure team is a team of “Generalists with Expertise” who adhere to DevOps principles by building software and services to automate all infrastructure operations. Our objective is to empower all our developers to build and own their systems end-to-end.
 
We're a modern infrastructure engineering team, believing strongly in testing, automation, and standardization through software. We operate in both physical data centers and AWS environments, and leverage open source technologies such as containers, MariaDB, NGINX, Jenkins, and Chef, as well as build tools and services using Go and Java to deliver automated infrastructure to our engineers and ultimately serve our clients.
 
About Wealthfront Engineering
Wealthfront’s culture centers around continuous learning, innovation, and quality-driven software development. With high quality software as our ultimate engineering objective, our key tactic is automation: 
 
• Wealthfront software automates the financial services we provide to our clients, and within these services we automate the collection of data that we learn from on our way to making our services even better.
 
• Wealthfront engineers function as builder/operators, with dual responsibility for building the system and operating it in production. Any toil that this brings about is automated away by engineers. This investment in automation is expected, and the prioritization of it is always built into our planning and execution.
 
• Wealthfront engineers automate our development processes. For example, Wealthfront engineers automate all of our testing. Manual testing is not part of the software development lifecycle at Wealthfront.
 
• Wealthfront engineers automate observability in case of failure. If something is up, our systems inform engineers appropriately. If our systems are quiet, they are healthy.
 
If you are drawn to being an engineer within such an environment, and having outsized impact as an engineer at a magnitude that is only available within a company achieving greatness at our size (~350 employees, half in engineering), then we want to hear from you!

descriptionPlain:
Wealthfront is looking for a Talent Intelligence Analyst to support hiring across Wealthfront, with a specific focus on our engineering organization. You'll work closely with executive partners across the company.
At Wealthfront we ask a lot from hiring managers, who often own the candidate engagement, starting with outreach and continuing throughout the hiring process.  This role will help to build a strong conviction in the companies, teams, profiles and individuals the hiring teams are offering their time to.  The right hire will be focused on efficiency, not volume.
A successful hire on this team will be comfortable forming a view before they have complete information, and equally comfortable revising it. They will be energized by getting fluent in technical domains, they write clearly under deadline, and they'd rather be specific and occasionally wrong than vague and unfalsifiable. They're strong cross-functional partners who understand a total addressable market and can focus hiring managers on who specifically to target as well as what to avoid. Success will require research rigor, clear writing, and sound judgment.

lists.content:
• Build and maintain talent maps for key functions—which companies, teams, and products actually produce the profile we need, and which present as adjacent but in reality are not
  • Write conviction packets for the candidates you advance: what they've built, the evidence behind it, the specific risks, and what an interview would need to resolve
  • Make and defend the negative call — we care as much about who you screened out and why as who you passed forward
  • Help leaders better frame roles and requirements based on talent market insights
  • Identify passive candidates through technical communities, conference talks, open source contributions, and published work — not just search results
  • Pull and structure the underlying data: talent flows between competitors, team growth signals, comp and title benchmarks, where a given skill set is concentrated
  • Contribute to the team's frameworks, templates, and sourcing playbooks

• 2+ years producing written analyses that someone acted on — executive search research, talent intelligence, technical sourcing, equity research, consulting, or a similar analytical role.  Reps with focused research is more critical than recruiting experience.
  • A systems thinking orientation with the ability to analyze discrete decisions and their downstream consequences.
  • An ability to take messy inputs and shape them into a clear, concise output.
  • Ability to read a technical background and find the signal: a GitHub history, a conference talk, an engineering blog post, a promotion trajectory. 
  • Strong written communication, with a habit of writing with high specificity.
  • Comfortable calibrating with senior leaders: clearly stating how confident you are and what evidence would change it. 
  • Willingness to disagree constructively, including with a hiring partner who likes a candidate you don’t.
  • Bachelor's or Master’s Degree
